reference_bar: Feynman's scientific-integrity standard and independently reproducible program-search evidence
publication_scope: A sanitized exploratory pilot and a falsifiable research protocol, not a claim of established general self-improvement.

acceptance_rules.requirement: Account for all 20 candidate requests, both arms and both generations. Do not select only winners for the public results.
Replay generated program behavior against the frozen original, selection, and reserved audit cases. Hash validity or model self-reports cannot substitute for output agreement.
Use a countercheck independent of the original recorded grades and explicitly state the relationship between the execution interpreter, oracle, and verifier.
Deliberately corrupt an artifact, a RAPP link, a source body, a result, and an original-use-case behavior; the relevant gates must fail. Missing measurements fail.
Check actual nonzero frame chains against the pinned current RAPP/1 reference, preserving exactly 11 envelope fields and distinguishing particle links from cross-stream provenance.

Publish only allowlisted synthetic study material and public reference code. Reject credentials, home paths, machine addresses, raw account/session identifiers, unrelated source, and private diagnostic logs.
State the direct-repair tie, first-generation ceiling, restricted execution language, pretrained-model contribution, absent causal ablations, and blocked model-mediated demonstrations.
Cite primary prior art and distinguish a proposed role-pivoted co-evolution architecture from the fixed-lens experiment actually performed.
Any stronger study protocol fixes hypotheses, controls, budgets, scoring, exclusions, stop rules, and disconfirming outcomes before collecting its primary data.
Resolve or explicitly narrow claims around independently reproduced blocker/major findings. Never edit original observations to satisfy a desired conclusion.
Preserve the predecessor paper and its evidence release. Existing repository checks and added targeted gates pass; public URLs serve the intended commit and files.

not_a_stop_condition: A positive effect in favor of the proposed mechanism.
A more impressive adjective or a larger frame count.
An assurance from the author or an AI reviewer.
A claim that the system has no possible errors.
